text: XL. 1. Bhinnaṃ pana bhante saṅghaṃ samaggaṃ katvā kiṃ so pasavatī ti? 2. Brahmaṃ Ānanda puññaṃ pasavatī ti. 3. Kiṃ pana bhante brahmaṃ puññan ti? 4. Kappaṃ Ānanda saggamhi modatī ti. [page 077] XL.4-XLI.3 Upāli-Akkosa-Vagga. 77 Sukhā saṅghassa sāmaggī samaggānañ ca anuggaho samaggarato dhammaṭṭho yogakkhemā na dhaṃsati saṅghaṃ samaggaṃ katvāna kappaṃ saggamhi modatī ti. Upālivaggo catuttho. Tatr'; uddānaṃ: Upāli ṭṭhapana ubbāho upasampadanissayena ca Sāmaṇero ca dve bhedā Ānandehi apare dve ti.
